connections.description: Yanzhong’s wife: the manuscript describes moving her burial from the home village to Xiqiao. The dashed line connects approximate areas; it does not trace the route or assign a relocation year. The village marker separately records Yanzhong’s settlement.

Zhenbang: the same entry records his death at Bonishibi and burial at Queenstown. Port Elizabeth is a tentative identification of Bonishibi. The dashed line associates these approximate places; no traveled route or burial date is recorded.
